card.title: IPhone 11 with half backlight on display

source.title: IPhone 11 with half backlight on display

claims.statement: iPhone 11 has two backlight circuits, so a dark bottom-left or bottom-right corner points to one of them.
Most common: a blown 0 Ω 0201 output resistor; also shorts on PP_DISPLAY_BL12_ANODE or BL34_ANODE that can destroy coils, caps, diodes and the IC.
Backlight ICs U5650 / U5660 are LM3539A1 and readily available.

procedure: Diode-check backlight lines at the LCD FPC.
Check output resistors (0 Ω 0201) under the top-board shield.
Rebuild the affected circuit if an anode is shorted; replace LM3539A1.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
